cli.argname.name: name
cli.cmd.agent-info.summary: Summary for agents: program and protocol version, compatible skill version, commands with levels, data paths. Use --json for machine parsing.
cli.cmd.autostart.set.summary: Turn starting with Windows on or off (needs administrator rights).
cli.cmd.check.list.summary: Check all the domains of a list (in parallel), like “Check list” in the window.
cli.cmd.check.site.summary: Check one domain: whether it is reachable from this computer and whether it is in the block registry.
cli.cmd.check.status.summary: State of the block registry service (version, update date).
cli.cmd.config.export.summary: Build a config to send: sections from --sections (by default the portable ones: lists,proxy,hosts,dns,telegram; winws depends on the provider and is included only explicitly). The proxy link and secrets are not included. --file writes it to a file.
cli.cmd.config.get.arg.key: setting name; without it, all of them
cli.cmd.config.get.summary: Show the program settings: all of them or one.
cli.cmd.config.import-preview.summary: Show what someone else's config would change (a file, or `-` for stdin): what would be applied, what skipped, what needs confirmation. Changes nothing.
cli.cmd.config.import.arg.confirm: allow foreign DNS/hosts servers and Telegram domains
cli.cmd.config.import.summary: Apply someone else's config (sections from --sections, by default all except the provider-dependent ones). Look at `config import-preview` first. Foreign DNS/hosts servers and Telegram domains only with --confirm. The files are copied to data/backups before anything is applied.
cli.cmd.config.set.arg.value: true/false, a number or a string
cli.cmd.config.set.summary: Change a setting. Available are the ones the window changes: ui_backend, auto_elevate, close_to_tray, update_channel, update_check, theme (system, light or dark), lang (auto, ru or en). Anything else means editing config.json by hand.
cli.cmd.discord.clear-cache.summary: Clear the Discord cache (Discord must be closed).
cli.cmd.dns.ping.arg.id: provider; without it, all of them
cli.cmd.dns.ping.summary: Ping DNS providers: all of them or one.
cli.cmd.dns.probe-config.summary: Probe domains: show them, or set --bypass and --ad.
cli.cmd.dns.probe.summary: Check whether a provider answers for “bypass” and ad domains.
cli.cmd.dns.record-start.summary: Start recording a site's domains: it remembers the names in the Windows DNS cache (the cache is flushed if you have administrator rights).
cli.cmd.dns.record-stop.summary: Finish recording: the domains that appeared since the start, grouped by main domain; trackers are marked. Open the site you need between start and stop.
cli.cmd.dns.reset.summary: Return an adapter's DNS to automatic (DHCP).
cli.cmd.dns.set.summary: Set a DNS provider on an adapter (needs administrator rights).
cli.cmd.dns.state.summary: Adapters, their current DNS and providers.
cli.cmd.dns.trial-confirm.arg.adapter: adapter number; without it, all of them
cli.cmd.dns.trial-confirm.summary: Keep the new DNS after `dns trial`; without an adapter, all pending ones.
cli.cmd.dns.trial-revert.arg.adapter: adapter number; without it, all of them
cli.cmd.dns.trial-revert.summary: Bring the previous DNS back right away, without waiting for the timer.
cli.cmd.dns.trial.summary: Set DNS with an automatic rollback: if you do not confirm within --seconds seconds, the previous one comes back.
cli.cmd.docs.summary: Documentation for this version of the program. Topics: commands, layout (folders and files), output (exit codes and the --json format). Without a topic, the table of contents; with --json, everything in machine-readable form.
cli.cmd.doctor.summary: Diagnostics: rights, WinDivert driver, ports, foreign processes, system proxy. --report gives Markdown for an issue (proxy links and secrets are hidden). Changes nothing.
cli.cmd.hosts.assign.summary: Bind lists to providers: provider=list,list (empty unbinds). Only the providers you name change; --replace replaces all bindings.
cli.cmd.hosts.background.summary: Settings of the hosts background thread: key=value (the value is JSON).
cli.cmd.hosts.off.summary: Turn the hosts substitution off: the block is removed from the file, bindings stay.
cli.cmd.hosts.on.summary: Turn the hosts substitution on (bindings are kept).
cli.cmd.hosts.overview.summary: Everything about hosts: providers, lists, bindings, state.
cli.cmd.hosts.ping.summary: Check that a hosts provider is reachable.
cli.cmd.hosts.provider-add.summary: Add a hosts provider (name, DoH address, servers).
cli.cmd.hosts.state.summary: State of the hosts substitution: applied or not, how many entries.
cli.cmd.lang.catalog.arg.language: ru or en; without it, the current one
cli.cmd.lang.catalog.summary: The whole text catalog of a language (for the window and for checks): key → text. Without a language, the current one.
cli.cmd.lang.set.summary: Choose the program language: auto (as in Windows), ru or en. The `--lang` flag and the CHIMERA_LANG variable take priority.
cli.cmd.lang.show.summary: Program language: what is chosen in the settings, what is in effect now and what the system uses.
cli.cmd.lists.add.summary: Add domains to a list (the list is created if it does not exist). Applied right away.
cli.cmd.lists.apply.arg.name: list; without it, all of them
cli.cmd.lists.apply.summary: Apply a list to the bypass, proxy and hosts now (without a name, all of them). Usually unnecessary: the running program picks up edits to lists/*.txt on disk by itself, and saving with `lists save` applies right away. Needs a running Chimera, with the window or in the tray.
cli.cmd.lists.create.arg.name: Latin letters, digits, . - _
cli.cmd.lists.rename.summary: Rename a list together with the references to it.
cli.cmd.lists.save.arg.name: list
cli.cmd.lists.save.summary: Write a whole list from a file (--file) or stdin.
cli.cmd.lists.show.arg.name: list; without it, all of them
cli.cmd.lists.show.summary: Lists with domain counts and connections; with a name, the contents of that list.
cli.cmd.lists.validate.arg.name: list; without it, all of them
cli.cmd.lists.validate.summary: Check a list file without changing anything: encoding, domain and subnet syntax, duplicates. Without a name, all lists. Errors mean exit code 1.
cli.cmd.lists.validate.ui: Command line only: checking a file before it is applied
cli.cmd.logs.arg.tail: how many last lines (40 by default)
cli.cmd.logs.summary: Last lines of a module's log: winws, proxy or tg.
cli.cmd.panic.summary: Turn everything off at once: bypass, proxy, Telegram proxy, service, hosts substitution; put DNS back on the adapters where Chimera set it. The steps are independent, so one failing does not stop the others. Only when the user asks.
cli.cmd.panic.ui: Overview → “Turn everything off”, tray icon menu
cli.cmd.path.add.summary: Add the program folder to the user's PATH (after that `chimera` works from any folder).
cli.cmd.path.remove.summary: Remove the program folder from the user's PATH.
cli.cmd.path.show.summary: Whether the program folder is in the user's PATH.
cli.cmd.proxy.apps-running.summary: Programs the user is running right now (for picking them for selective TUN).
cli.cmd.proxy.apps.summary: Apps for selective TUN, by executable name (Discord.exe). No names clears them.
cli.cmd.proxy.autostart.summary: Start the proxy when Chimera starts.
cli.cmd.proxy.core-download.summary: Download the sing-box core (pinned version, SHA256 verified).
cli.cmd.proxy.link.summary: Set the proxy link (vless://, trojan://, ss://, vmess://). `-` reads it from stdin, `--clear` removes it.
cli.cmd.proxy.lists.summary: Which lists go through the proxy (no names clears them). Applied right away.
cli.cmd.proxy.mode.summary: Proxy mode: pac (no admin needed), split (selective TUN) or tun (all traffic).
cli.cmd.proxy.state.summary: Proxy state: running or not, mode, lists, domain count, core.
cli.cmd.service.summary: Background service: install, uninstall, start, stop, status, run (like `main.py service`).
cli.cmd.sources.check.arg.name: source; without a name, all of them
cli.cmd.sources.check.summary: Compare source versions with GitHub (all of them or one).
cli.cmd.sources.update.arg.name: source from `chimera sources versions`
cli.cmd.sources.update.summary: Pull the latest version of a source (git fetch + checkout).
cli.cmd.sources.versions.summary: Local versions of the external sources (no network).
cli.cmd.start.summary: Start Chimera without a window, in the tray. The program itself asks for administrator rights.
cli.cmd.status.summary: State of the app and its modules: bypass, proxy, Telegram proxy, hosts.
cli.cmd.stop.summary: Close Chimera and shut its modules down.
cli.cmd.tg.advanced.summary: Advanced core settings: key=value (the value is JSON or a string).
cli.cmd.tg.check-update.summary: Check for an update of the Telegram proxy core.
cli.cmd.tg.config.arg.host: address; 0.0.0.0 opens it to devices on the network
cli.cmd.tg.config.summary: Change the address, port, secret or autostart (everything else stays as is).
cli.cmd.tg.link.summary: The tg://proxy link to connect with (the secret is hidden without --show-secrets).
cli.cmd.tg.regen-secret.summary: Generate a new secret (the old link stops working).
cli.cmd.tg.state.summary: State of the Telegram proxy and its settings.
cli.cmd.tg.stats.summary: Counters of the running Telegram proxy.
cli.cmd.update.check.summary: Check whether a new version is out.
cli.cmd.update.install.summary: Download, verify and install the version that was found; the program restarts.
cli.cmd.update.state.summary: Update state: current and found versions, stage.
cli.cmd.version.summary: Program version and command-line protocol version.
cli.cmd.winws.autostart.summary: Start the strategy when Chimera starts.
cli.cmd.winws.fake.summary: Put a fake blob into a slot (discord or game).
cli.cmd.winws.filters.summary: Filter state: game, ipset, fake blobs.
cli.cmd.winws.game.summary: Game filter: off, all, tcp or udp; ports are optional.
cli.cmd.winws.ipset.summary: ipset mode: none, any or loaded.
cli.cmd.winws.lists.summary: Which domain lists to send through the bypass (no names clears them). Applied right away.
cli.cmd.winws.start.arg.strategy: id from `chimera winws strategies`; the last one by default
cli.cmd.winws.start.summary: Start a strategy. Without a name, the last one used.
cli.cmd.winws.state.summary: Bypass state: running or not, strategy, lists, error, version.
cli.config.needs_confirm: Some items need confirmation (!): apply with --confirm, and only if you trust the author.
cli.err.app_too_old: Chimera is too old (protocol {app}, while the command line needs {need}). Run `chimera update`.
cli.err.config_forbidden: The setting {key} cannot be changed from the command line.
cli.err.forbidden: Chimera denied access: the link file is stale. Repeat the command.
cli.err.no_strategy: No strategy is chosen and none has been run before. List: chimera winws strategies.
cli.err.not_running: Chimera is not running. Start it with `chimera start` or open the window.
cli.err.not_running_detail: Chimera is not running ({detail}). Start it with `chimera start` or open the window.
cli.err.restart_start_wait: Chimera did not come back after the restart. Start it with `chimera start`.
cli.err.restart_stop_timeout: Chimera did not close for the restart.

cli.err.stop_timeout: Chimera did not close in the allotted time.
cli.err.tg_no_link: The link is not available: the Telegram proxy core did not load.

cli.help.main:
Chimera — bypass blocks from the command line.

Usage:
  chimera <command> [action] [parameters]
  chimera --window | --browser          open the window or a browser tab

Commands:
{commands}

Common parameters (can go anywhere):
  --json           machine output: {"schema": 1, "ok": …, "command": …, "level": …, "data": …}
  --show-secrets   show links and secrets (hidden by default)
  --lang ru|en     output language (by default from the settings, see `chimera lang show`)
  -h, --help       this help; `chimera <command> --help` for help on a command
  --version        version

Exit codes:
{codes}

More: `chimera docs` (commands, folder layout, --json format).

cli.path.not_there: The folder was not in PATH.
cli.tg.secret_hidden: The secret is hidden. Full link: chimera tg link --show-secrets
cli.usage.link_needed: Give a link (or `-` to read it from stdin), or --clear.
cli.usage.need_action: Give an action for {group}: {actions}. Help: chimera {group} --help
cli.usage.no_action: The command {group} has no action {action}. Available: {actions}.
cli.usage.unknown_command: Unknown command {group}. List of commands: chimera --help
docs.flag.lang: output language: ru or en (by default from the settings)
docs.json.command: the command without parameters, for example `winws start`
docs.json.data: what the app method returned, losslessly; for composite commands (status, check) a summary
docs.json.error: when ok=false: {code, message, key, params}; code is usage, not_running, app_too_old, remote_error, forbidden, …; key and params are the message key in the catalog and its parameters (not every error has them); message depends on the language, code and key do not
docs.json.level: read | app | system: what the command changes (only when ok=true)
docs.json.schema: output format version (currently 1); it grows only on incompatible changes
docs.layout.changes_log: Change log: time, source (`cli` for a command, `file` for a list edit on disk), command, result (`ok` or `error`).
docs.layout.config_json: Program settings. Change them with `chimera config set` (some keys only by editing the file).
docs.layout.control_json: Port and token of the control channel. An agent does not need to read it; do not show it.
docs.layout.dns_user_json: DNS providers added by the user. `chimera dns provider-…` commands.
docs.layout.hostlist_general_user: Built from the lists selected for the bypass. Do not edit.
docs.layout.hosts_json: Bindings of lists to hosts providers, background options. `chimera hosts …` commands.
docs.layout.ipset_all: The common subnet list (ipset mode). Changed by `chimera winws ipset …` commands.
docs.layout.ipset_exclude_user: Exclusion subnets for the bypass. Edit only when the user asks.
docs.layout.ipset_user: Subnets from the selected lists. Do not edit.
docs.layout.list_exclude_user: Exclusion domains for the bypass. Edit only when the user asks.
docs.layout.lists_txt: Domain and subnet lists, one entry per line, # starts a comment. Commands `chimera lists …`. The running program picks up direct edits to the file by itself within a couple of seconds (create, change, delete); check a file with `chimera lists validate`.
docs.layout.logs: Module logs (winws, proxy, tgproxy, hosts, service, update). Read them with `chimera logs <module>`.
docs.layout.proxy_json: Proxy link (credentials), mode, lists, apps. Do not read or show.
docs.layout.proxy_pac: The PAC file of the pac mode. Rebuilt.
docs.layout.singbox_config: sing-box config. Rebuilt by the program.
docs.layout.singbox_domains: Domains of the lists selected for the proxy (a sing-box rule file). Rebuilt.
docs.layout.singbox_ips: Subnets of the lists selected for the proxy. Rebuilt.
docs.layout.strategies_txt: winws2 strategies, ported from Flowseal (tools/port_flowseal.py). Do not edit.
docs.layout.tgproxy_json: Port, secret and parameters of the Telegram proxy. Do not read or show.
docs.layout.winws_json: Last strategy, selected lists, bypass autostart. Change with `chimera winws …` commands.
